replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Sometimes, yes—especially with complex topics like calculus. But I’ve learned to break problems into smaller steps, which helps reduce stress. I use techniques like mindfulness and talking through problems with friends to stay calm.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI tool to solve practice problems and get step-by-step explanations. It helped me understand where I went wrong and reinforced concepts. The tool was user-friendly and great for self-paced learning.

To find stationary points, take the first derivative f’(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. Plug those x-values back into f(x) to get the y-coordinates. Check if they’re maxima or minima using the second derivative test.
